alive.last_commit_message:
Show inherited Work stages on subproject chats and in the Subprojects list (#1314)

* Show inherited Work stages on subproject chats and in the Subprojects list

Running goal chats in research subprojects showed no Work stage after
#1313. Two defects:

- chat_work_stage labelled a stage only from the item's own project's
  work_stages. Subprojects define none and inherit their nearest
  ancestor's (WorkService.effective_stages, the Work page), so a valid
  inherited key such as "recon" was dropped. The join now walks parents,
  one ancestry level per query, and a project's own stages still win.
- The parent's Subprojects list (GET /chat/projects/{id}/linked-chats)
  never joined the stage, and ChildProjectConversations never rendered
  it. Core now adds metadata.work_stage there, and the row shows the
  Work stage label with the stage in the link's accessible name.

Nothing is stored, so existing chats pick it up on the next read. Product
help notes the inheritance and the Subprojects list.
